validation.mode: Verified retained development evidence, not seal receipts or a new release qualification
validation.workspaceBuild: retained passed result; production and build inputs unchanged

performance.layout: Reconstruct each original PS-08 report from shared fields, run fields excluding id/cells, and ordered cells formed by merging fixture identity with run cell. Every sample and statistic is retained.

dependencies.workspacePreparation: lockfile install with scripts disabled; pnpm build required before run

cache.warm: same process after warmup; fresh request lifecycle

timing.buildMs: CLI imports, project resolution and buildProject; excludes fixture setup and worker startup
timing.coldLoadMs: artifact reads and runtime imports; JavaScript application/codecs import; Native instantiation occurs in requests
timing.firstRequestMs: first complete provider-host request including request construction/body materialization, Native validation/compilation/instantiation and mandatory request disposal
timing.warmRequestMs: same complete request after warmup, including request construction, body materialization and mandatory disposal; correctness assertions outside timer
timing.cleanupMs: delete per-cell project and build outputs after all samples; excluded from build/load/request
timing.compilerPeakRssBytes: maximum individual ASC process resourceUsage.maxRSS, including its source-map re-exec; never summed; Native only; JavaScript compiler/build worker high-water RSS (includes imports/writer)
timing.artifactBytes: Native executable Wasm; JavaScript emitted executable .js/.cjs modules and schema codecs; dependencies/inspection excluded

protocol.request: fixtures.cases[0]; in-memory Node provider fixture fetch, no network or HTTP server
protocol.runtime: workspace Node provider host, generated JavaScript source package / canonical Native Wasm
protocol.instrumentation: test-owned spawnSync wrapper preloads resourceUsage exit recorder into ASC; no production source hooks

performance.interpretation: All artifacts are byte-identical. Small descriptive samples show variation; no performance or size improvement is established. Archived comparisons are not causal attribution.

remainingLargestResponsibilities.work: Split operation-family rendering only when a concrete syntax or semantic change needs it; preserve reverse aliases and assignment/short-circuit ordering.
Composition already reuses codec owners. Any later validation deletion needs a specific equivalence argument and surviving rejection owner.
Construction and layout are separated. Keep IDs, loop target patching, routing boundaries, character charging and visit-weight allowance with this owner.
Mostly frozen manifest fields and result assembly; no urgent additional split is justified.

limitations: Three build/cold samples and ninety warm requests per cell, clustered in three processes; no significance claim.
OS caches are uncontrolled; Native requests include validation/compilation/instantiation and request disposal.
Compiler RSS measures individual ASC high-water RSS, not total toolchain/request memory.
Three small Node fixtures do not qualify large catalogs, Fastly deployment, ESP32 or release publication.
No aggregate seal is selected by this documentation-only diff; no new gate or optimizer campaign.
